body: The new describe block and its section/inline comments (lines 125, 137, 51) label the story CAM-241/316, but this branch's issue is CAM-326 (the file header at line 13 and prd.json correctly say 326). Cosmetic mislabel; align the 316 references to 326. Non-blocking; already noted in handoff openQuestions as out of scope for US-R1-001.
